GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

18. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

19. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

20. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
